newsitem.title: JAPAN: HK's Pacific Concord seeks to list in Osaka -- paper.
newsitem.headline: HK's Pacific Concord seeks to list in Osaka -- paper.

text.p: Hong Kong's Pacific Concord Holding Ltd is likely to be listed on the foreign section of the Osaka Securities Exchange (OSE) as early as October, Japanese newspapers reported on Thursday.

It would become company to list on the section, which was set up by the Osaka bourse in October 1996 in an attempt to attract Asian firms. The section has easier listing requirements than its counterpart in Tokyo.
An OSE official told Reuters on Thursday that the bourse had not received a final application from the company.
"I have heard about this company through securities companies but we have not received a final application to list at this point," said Tomochika Ito, a director at OSE's listing department.
Pacific Concord officials were not immediately available for comment.
Pacific Concord, which is currently listed on the stock exchange of Hong Kong, manufactures and sells watches, watch components and cosmetics, and is also engaged in hotel management.
